source.transfer: Operator copied the guest JSON to the host after reporting successful completion

post_transfer_queue_snapshot.count_interpretation: At least 4096 nodes at the paused snapshot after operator transfer
post_transfer_queue_snapshot.limitation: Includes guest activity before and after the 100-pair benchmark and file transfer; growth cannot be attributed to the benchmark.

measurement.percentile_method: Nearest rank: sorted samples at ceil(p*n)-1; median averages the two middle values for n=100

limitations: No corrected fresh-device benchmark has yet been supplied; no speedup or causal performance conclusion is established.
Metadata-only handles omit XInput's read/write access and enumeration IOCTLs; these are not game frame times or a full reproduction of its path.
Timing includes interop, scheduling and last-error retrieval; all samples, including the first, are retained.
The 100-pair cap ended the run before the five-second time limit; this was not five measured seconds of benchmark activity.
Queue population can grow between the debugger snapshot, operator start and timed calls; 1994 is not a verified queue count for each sample.
The operator was asked to leave the controller untouched; independent input activity and fidelity were not measured.
Retired-device teardown remained incomplete at its earlier inspection, and benchmark timing alone does not establish the cause of that state.
Service inventory was collected after the timed interval; the exact per-user worker identity was established separately by kernel observations.
Raw interface path remains in the ignored file and is omitted here.
